purpose.summary: This is a subprogram (ORCSNYUACCT) belonging to the ORCA open-source Japanese medical receipt (claims) software developed by the Japan Medical Association (JMA). It handles inpatient accounting record creation and maintenance, including admission processing, discharge processing, cancellation, transfer, and next-month record generation for hospital billing.

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually EUC-JP encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system (Japan Medical Association). The COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown here, so full structural analysis is incomplete, but the program structure is unambiguously production COBOL.
